{{Top|leg}}
'''Efellis''' was a floating [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Caarimon]]. It was located to the north of the city of [[Joventusek]] and was home to the planet's [[Filordus|Filordi]] population. It was considered by Caarimon's main [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Caarite]]s, to be the "underworld" of Caarimon.
